checks.detail: Runtime: preflight, replay, capture_evidence, tester_lifecycle and external_activation all pass on fresh builds bound to candidate sha 457f6746 with source_unchanged/binary_unchanged and disposable isolation (native.host.0/2/3/6/8). Interface: all six signed-in surfaces captured with correct headings and coherent empty states (surfaces-lynp41pa); replay drive shows an actionable validation message ('Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.') with baseline labels present (native.host.2). Persistence: rust-unit 50/50 including register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists and v3-subtask migration without data loss; Settings shows SENT delivery state with test-email action (native.host.1; screenshot-0-5). Security: least-privilege capabilities (core:event:default only), scoped CSP, generic rate-limited sign-in errors, private-op rejection and single-use token tests (src-tauri config; native.host.1). Visual: surfaces match PRD 9 editorial direction (restrained accent, icons+text, thin rules, no prohibited patterns); 640px narrow capture preserves task hierarchy. Residuals are measurement debt, tracked as findings: PRD 9.2 network-error state not_run (no fault-injection hook), 390px integrity unmeasured (window minWidth 640), isolated_native_store advisory flag false. Journey completion is judged under prd_golden_path.

White-box layer green: tsc, vite build, cargo fmt/check and rust-unit 50/50 including golden_path_section3_self_drive, malformed/expired/reused reset-token recoverability, and restart persistence (native.host.1). Black-box layer incomplete: the independent host journey drive executed 8 of 18 steps (steps 1-7 passed with redacted isolated-mail-sink observations) and blocked at create_task ('control not found: [data-testid=task-detail-toggle]'), independently_verified=false, collector_exit_code=1; host verification marks journey_drive unmeasured (native.host.7, native.host.verification). The failure point shows PRD 6.3-correct product behavior (no-due-date quick-add stays in Inbox; screenshot-7-7), so this is a manifest action-path incompatibility, not an observed product defect. PRD 3 steps 8-11 outcomes (focus running/paused/completed, exact-once completion, reminder email delivery, sign-out/in persistence) and all four recovery states remain independently unverified after 16 treatments. Replay, static validation, the untrusted 16/16 product self-drive (counts_match=false vs 18 declared) and partial journey success cannot prove the full business path, so the criterion stays blocked.

finding_optional_fields.details: Small JSON object for MCP/runtime facts needed by the next Planner/Developer, such as node_path, mcp_tool, screenshot_id, observed_transform.position, observed_transform.rotation_degrees, expected_transform, and retest_recipe. Keep prose concise; preserve evidence IDs, dispositions, reproduction and retest steps.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.
Verify the complete auth, task, focus, reminder, recovery, and persistence path in both black-box and white-box layers.

developer_outcome.summary: Every predicate checked against shipped state. Unverified: opaque project-id select value (covered via Projects-column assertion); focus running/paused transitions not end-state predicates (final Completed asserted); exact-once count and '1 task completed.' sentence (no count predicate); reset two-phase headings need per-sub-action observation. Business pass gated on Host+Tester.

risk_note.summary: Valid assertion syntax may still reference an unreachable state or omit part of a business outcome.
risk_note.validation: Check every predicate against shipped state and report exact unverified outcomes; only independent Host evidence and Tester review establish business pass.
risk_note.why_now: The missing executable measurement contract currently prevents independent collection.

task_requirements.requirement: All 18 steps have executable predicates and all four navigation views have their own assertions accepted by the Host contract validator.
Every predicate observes the corresponding frozen business outcome using the shipped UI or isolated mail sink.
All required steps, recovery states, actions, locators and business outcomes are preserved; changes are confined to quality/first-run-journey.json.
The handoff identifies any unverified outcome or action incompatibility and leaves it blocked for independent measurement.
